plans.title: 30-Day Crash Course: Prelims Speed Sprint
plans.tagline: Best for candidates with pending exams within 4 weeks (SBI/IBPS/RRB Clerk Prelims).

phases.title: Speed Math & Calculation Mastery
phases.description: Lock down 20 marks in 10 minutes. Tables up to 25, squares 1-50, cubes 1-25, fraction-percentage conversions, Vedic criss-cross, and sign-flip rule.
dailyTasks: Day 1: Multiplication hacks (Vedic criss-cross, base 100, squaring ending in 5)
Day 2: Fraction-percentage wheel (1/1 to 1/20) + 30 Simplification questions
Day 3: VBODMAS rule deep dive + 40 Simplification questions
Day 4: Approximation techniques + 40 Approximation questions
Day 5: Quadratic Equations (Sign-flip method) + 30 Quadratic questions
Day 6: Missing Number Series patterns + 30 Series questions
Day 7: Wrong Number Series diagnostics + 25 Series questions
Day 8: Speed Math Sprint Test: 35 questions in 18 minutes + Error analysis

phases.title: High-Yield Arithmetic & DI Basics
phases.description: Master the arithmetic topics that provide 100% predictable marks: Ratio, Ages, Partnership, Percentage, P&L, Time & Work.
dailyTasks: Day 9: Percentage & Successive % change + 25 questions
Day 10: Ratio & Proportion + 25 questions
Day 11: Ages & Partnership + 30 questions
Day 12: Tabular Data Interpretation (5 sets) + 20 Simplification
Day 13: Bar & Line Graph DI (5 sets) + 20 Simplification
Day 14: Profit, Loss & Marked Price + 25 questions
Day 15: Time & Work (LCM method) + 25 questions
Day 16: Pipes & Cisterns + 20 questions
Day 17: Simple & Compound Interest (Difference formulas) + 25 questions
Day 18: Full Sectional Mock 1 (35 Q, 20 min) + Revision of all mistakes

phases.title: Intensive Mock Drills & Exam Simulation
phases.description: Daily timed mocks, question selection training (what to skip in first 30s), and eliminating negative marks.
dailyTasks: Day 19: Time Speed Distance, Trains & Boats (Core formulas) + 20 questions
Day 20: Mixture & Alligation + 20 questions
Day 21: Pie Chart DI & Mixed DI (5 sets)
Day 22: Prelims Mock Test 1 + In-depth Post-Test Analysis
Day 23: Speed Lab Sprints (15s & 25s drill) + 40 mixed questions
Day 24: Prelims Mock Test 2 + Error Log review
Day 25: Question Selection Practice (First 5-minute scan drill)
Day 26: Prelims Mock Test 3 + Sectional Cutoff validation
Day 27: Formula Flashcards Revision + 50 Simplification sprint
Day 28: Prelims Mock Test 4 + Calm mindset conditioning
Day 29: Final Full Mock Test + Revise My Mistakes hub
Day 30: Relaxed light formula scan, proper sleep, exam center readiness
